id: \bFalkner uses Flying type Pokémon. They are weak aganst Electric, Ice, and Rock types.
en: \bFalkner uses Flying type Pokémon. They are weak aganst Electric, Ice, and Rock types.
it: \bValerio usa Pokémon di tipo Volante. Sono deboli contro i tipi Elettro, Ghiaccio e Roccia.

id: \bThey are strong against Bug, Grass, and Fighting. Those types also don't do much damage. They are immune to Ground types as well.
en: \bThey are strong against Bug, Grass, and Fighting.  Those types also don't do much damage. They are immune to Ground types as well.
it: \bSono forti contro Coleottero, Erba e Lotta. Anche questi tipi non fanno molti danni. In più sono immuni al tipo Terra.
\bI miei tipi Volante ti faranno precipitare.

id: \bFalkner: Ah hello. I am Falkner, the Gym Leader of this city.
en: \bFalkner: Ah hello. I am Falkner, the Gym Leader of this city.
it: \bValerio: Ah, salve. Sono Valerio, il Capopalestra di questa città.

id: \bI would love to battle with you, but there seems to be some trouble at Sprout Tower right now.
en: \bI would love to battle with you, but there seems to be some trouble at Sprout Tower right now.
it: \bMi piacerebbe molto lottare con te, ma pare che ci siano dei problemi alla Torre Sprout in questo momento.

id: \bFalkner: I'm Falkner, the Gym Leader of this city.
en: \bFalkner: I'm Falkner, the Gym Leader of this city.
it: \bValerio: Sono Valerio, il Capopalestra di questa città.

id: \bMany people believe that Flying types can be brought down by electricity. I believe that is nonsense.
en: \bMany people believe that Flying types can be brought down by electricity. I believe that is nonsense.
it: \bIn molti credono che i tipi Volante possano essere abbattuti dall'elettricità. Secondo me sono sciocchezze.

id: \bNothing can bring down the might of my birds.
en: \bNothing can bring down the might of my birds.
it: \bNulla può abbattere la potenza dei miei uccelli.
\bValerio: Ti sei guadagnato la Medaglia Zefiro.

id: \bTM40 contains Aerial Ace. It will never miss.
en: \bTM40 contains Aerial Ace. It will never miss.
it: \bLa MT40 contiene Aeroassalto. Non manca mai il bersaglio.
\bValerio: Ricordati di volare sempre in alto.
